Saba Capital Management, L.P., a 10% owner of PIMCO Dynamic Income Strategy Fund (PDX), reported the sale of common stock totaling $406,836. The transactions, which involved 19,692 shares, occurred on September 16, 2026, with shares sold at a price of $20.66 each.

Following these sales, Saba Capital Management, L.P. beneficially owns 6,331,840 shares of PIMCO Dynamic Income Strategy Fund common stock. The filing indicates that the disposed shares were held directly, while the remaining beneficial ownership is indirect.

The fund, with a market cap of $901 million, currently trades at $20.16 and offers a dividend yield of 9.11%. According to InvestingPro Tips, PDX pays a significant dividend to shareholders and has delivered strong performance with a 16.5% return over the past year and 15.4% year-to-date.
